name: Israel
leaders: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu (Likud); President Isaac Herzog
leadersIs: Benjamin Netanyahu forsætisráðherra (Likud); Isaac Herzog forseti
summary: The 25th Knesset dissolved in July 2026. Polls show former army chief Gadi Eisenkot's Yashar ahead of Likud, with neither Netanyahu's bloc nor the opposition bloc reaching a 61-seat majority. Benny Gantz's Blue and White withdrew from the race on 19 October.
summaryIs: Knesset, 25. þing Ísraels, var leyst upp í júlí 2026. Kannanir sýna Yashar, flokk fyrrverandi herráðsforingjans Gadi Eisenkot, á undan Likud, en hvorki blokk Netanyahus né blokk stjórnarandstöðunnar nær 61 sætis meirihluta. Bláhvíta bandalagið, flokkur Bennys Gantz, dró framboð sitt til baka 19. október.
